messages.text: Arteta: Dowman could go out on loan in future

metadata.summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has not ruled out loaning out Max Dowman in the future and says the club evaluates the 16-year-old sensation's progress every six months.
metadata.content: Max Dowman: Mikel Arteta admits 16-year-old Arsenal wonderkid could go out on loan in the future | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Max Dowman: Mikel Arteta admits 16-year-old Arsenal wonderkid could go out on loan in the future Sam Blitz Football Journalist @SamBIitz Friday 18 September 2026 19:24, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta speaks on the potential loan move for midfield youngster Max Dowman. Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has not ruled out loaning out Max Dowman in the future and says the club evaluates the 16-year-old sensation's progress every six months. Dowman continued his rise by starting and scoring twice in Arsenal's Carabao Cup win over Ipswich this week. After the game, Gunners midfielder Mikel Merino compared the young teenager to Barcelona and Spain star Lamine Yamal. But those 90 minutes at Portman Road have been Dowman's only minutes of the season, and he did not make Arsenal's matchday squad in the wins over Aston Villa and Sunderland. messages.text: No charges against Carse after police close alleged assault investigation

metadata.summary: Brydon Carse will not face any charges after Derbyshire Police closed their investigation into an alleged assault following an incident involving the England cricketer at a nightclub in Derby.
metadata.content: Brydon Carse: No charges against England cricketer after police close investigation into alleged assault at nightclub | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Brydon Carse: No charges against England cricketer after police close investigation into alleged assault at nightclub Derbyshire Police have ended their investigation into an alleged assault incident which involved England and Durham cricketer Brydon Carse; Carse, who has played for Durham in the County Championship during the investigation over the last month, will not face any charges Friday 18 September 2026 19:25, UK Image: Brydon Carse will not face any charges after an investigation Brydon Carse will not face any charges after Derbyshire Police closed their investigation into an alleged assault following an incident involving the England cricketer at a nightclub in Derby. Last month, Carse was handcuffed outside a nightclub in Derby and missed the second and third Tests of England's series against Pakistan. The 31-year-old was celebrating with Durham players after their win at Derbyshire in the County Championship and was also seen talking to team-mate Matthew Potts with former England captain Ben Stokes also pictured in the background. messages.text: Gabriel edging closer to Man Utd exit as Barca and Real talks advance

metadata.summary: Barcelona and Real Madrid are in transfer talks to sign Manchester United youngster JJ Gabriel.
metadata.content: JJ Gabriel edging closer to Manchester United exit amid Barcelona talks about a potential move for the forward | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Transfer JJ Gabriel edging closer to Manchester United exit amid Barcelona talks about a potential move for the forward JJ Gabriel, 15, has made it clear he wants to leave Man Utd and has asked to be de-registered to become a free agent; Barcelona and Real Madrid talks advancing, PSG and Bayern also interested in the forward Danyal Khan Sky Sports News Reporter @DanyalHKhan Friday 18 September 2026 20:35, UK Image: JJ Gabriel could be set to depart Manchester United Barcelona and Real Madrid are in transfer talks to sign Manchester United youngster JJ Gabriel. The 15-year-old and his family are currently in Barcelona, where discussions with the Catalan club and their LaLiga rivals are advancing. PSG and Bayern Munich also remain interested in his signature. Gabriel and his team lodged a request earlier this week to leave United. The club's leadership have been hopeful they can persuade the young star to stay at the club as he is contracted until the end of the season, but it now looks increasingly likely he will move away from Old Trafford.
